members.snippet: 24-year-old TikToker Cesar Gastelum, was shot dead while livestreaming with friends outside a fast-food restaurant.

events.headline: Mamdani praises El-Sayed’s victory, rejects ‘mini Mamdani’ trope

members.title: Mamdani praises El-Sayed’s victory, rejects ‘mini Mamdani’ trope
members.snippet: New York City’s Mayor Zohran Mamdani congratulated Abdul El-Sayed on winning Michigan’s Democratic Senate primary.
